description: This Java class handles commands related to intermediary sales to external asset owners within the Fineract project. It implements a command handler interface and delegates the processing to an external service.

classes.name: IntermediarySaleToExternalAssetOwnerHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles intermediary sale commands and delegates processing to the ExternalAssetOwnersWriteService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JsonCommand to perform an intermediary sale of a loan by delegating to externalAssetOwnersWriteService.
